Data from `https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2026/2026-10-20/readme.md`


```{r}
ai_salary_majors %>% summarize(median = median(median_salary_4yr, na.rm = TRUE))

ai_salary_majors %>% 
  arrange 

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
p <- ggplot(
  data = ai_salary_majors, aes(x = ai_exposure, y = median_salary_4yr, 
                               label = paste0(
      "Major: ", field_of_study,
      "<br>Salary: $", scales::comma(median_salary_4yr),
      "<br>Graduates: ", scales::comma(n_graduates)))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 64445, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.0, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_graduates), alpha = 0.5)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "label")
```
